Let me take a different approach. I'll build the HDF5 library and create a valid HDF5 file with the right structure, then modify it to trigger the vulnerability. First, let me check if the library is already built:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "libhdf5.a" -o -name "h5_extended_fuzzer" 2>/dev/null | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
